howto.name: Paste your text
howto.text: Drop any string — a variable name, sentence, or paragraph — into the input box.

howto.name: Copy any case format
howto.text: All 12 case variants (camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase, CONSTANT_CASE, Title Case, sentence case, dot.case, path/case, and more) appear instantly. Click Copy on the one you want.

faq.a: 12: lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, dot.case, path/case, and iNVERSE.

faq.q: Will it handle existing camelCase or snake_case input correctly?
faq.a: Yes. The tool detects word boundaries from underscores, hyphens, spaces, and lowercase→uppercase transitions, so converting between any two cases works correctly.

faq.q: Does it run in my browser?
faq.a: Yes — 100%. Your text never leaves the page. Useful for renaming variables, generating CSS class names, or normalizing identifiers without exposing them to a server.
